description: Backend: remove the hardcoded dreamphysics seed and build the dynamic referral-code engine + evolved API. This is the foundation FEAT-002 (frontend) consumes, so it must land first. Covers: repurpose seedTrainer.ts into a generic bootstrap (no dreamphysics literal, no SEED_TRAINER_UID-as-sole-mechanism), a pure non-sequential code generator, trainerRepository index ops with the shared claimability predicate, trainerService referral-code lifecycle (ensureTrainerAccount/getReferralCode/generateReferralCode/setCustomReferralCode/checkAvailability), the one-active-trainer switch guard in linkStudent, the four /api/trainer/referral-code endpoints, POST /api/auth/register-trainer + confirmSwitch on link-trainer, POST /api/student/connect-trainer, the idempotent migrateReferralCodes.ts, and all backend unit + route-integration tests. Grounded in the real files read during exploration (backend/src/services/trainerService.ts, repositories/trainerRepository.ts, scripts/seedTrainer.ts, etc.). Independent of FEAT-003 but FEAT-002 depends on this API contract.

findings:
IMPLEMENTED on feat/trainer-student-2way (commit scoped backend files). Gate green: typecheck + lint + 149 vitest tests pass; nutritionService.test.ts untouched and green. No hardcoded dreamphysics seed/branch remains (only reserved-word list, migration grandfather comment, one test fixture).

=== API CONTRACT FOR FEAT-002 (frontend) ===
All responses use the ok() envelope: { success:true, data:<below> }.

Generated-code format: PREFIX + random suffix, PREFIX in {FIT,TRN,GYM,COACH}, suffix from uppercase A-Z + 2-9 EXCLUDING 0/O/1/I, total length 7-8 (e.g. FIT7K2P9, COACHW3Q, TRN8X3Q). Display casing is preserved; the lowercase form is the index key. Codes are case-insensitive on connect.

TRAINER referral-code endpoints (auth + requireTrainer):
- GET  /api/trainer/referral-code -> data.referralCode = { code: string|null, active: boolean, referralCodeUpdatedAt: string|null (ISO) }
- POST /api/trainer/referral-code (no body) -> data.referralCode = { code: string, active: true }  (regenerate; old index doc deactivated, trainerLinks untouched)
- PATCH /api/trainer/referral-code  body { code: string }  -> data.referralCode = { code: string, active: true }. Errors: 422 invalid format, 400 reserved word, 409 ConflictError 'That referral code is taken.' (owned by another trainer, active OR inactive).
- GET  /api/trainer/referral-code/availability?code=XXX -> data = { available: boolean, reason?: 'taken'|'reserved'|'invalid' } (available true also when the code is already the caller's own).

referralCodeSchema (custom/availability): required, trim, length 4-20, regex ^[A-Za-z0-9]+$ (no spaces/symbols), reserved rejected case-insensitively: admin, trainer, fittrack, support, null, undefined, dreamphysics.

AUTH:
- POST /api/auth/register-trainer  body { name: string(1-80) } (NO referral-code field)  -> data = { trainerId: string, referralCode: string|null }. Idempotent: re-call returns the same referralCode, never a duplicate trainer. Role set server-side from the verified token (uid/email/picture); 401 without a token.
- POST /api/auth/link-trainer  body now accepts optional confirmSwitch: boolean (existing referralCode field unchanged).

STUDENT:
- POST /api/student/connect-trainer  body { referralCode: string, confirmSwitch?: boolean } -> SAME LinkResult as link-trainer (shared linkStudent service; thin alias). GET /api/student/trainer unchanged.

LinkResult JSON (data of link-trainer / connect-trainer), always HTTP 200 unless noted:
  { linked: boolean,
    reason?: 'invalid_code' | 'already_linked',
    trainerId?: string,
    trainerName?: string,
    alreadyLinked?: boolean,   // true when re-linking the SAME trainer (idempotent no-op)
    switched?: boolean,        // true after a confirmed switch
    currentTrainer?: { trainerId: string, name: string|null },   // only on already_linked
    requestedTrainer?: { trainerId: string, name: string|null } } // only on already_linked
Branches:
  - unknown/inactive code OR resolved account not an active trainer -> { linked:false, reason:'invalid_code' } (indistinguishable on purpose).
  - no existing active link -> { linked:true, trainerId, trainerName } (+1 live student).
  - active link to SAME trainer -> { linked:true, trainerId, trainerName, alreadyLinked:true } (no double count).
  - active link to DIFFERENT trainer, confirmSwitch not true -> { linked:false, reason:'already_linked', currentTrainer, requestedTrainer } (NO write). currentTrainer.name may be null if trainer A was deleted -> frontend should degrade copy to 'your current trainer'.
  - active link to DIFFERENT trainer, confirmSwitch===true -> { linked:true, switched:true, trainerId, trainerName } (link row trainerId updated + profile.trainerId re-mirrored; NO stored-counter write; live countActiveStudents gives A-1/B+1).
  - a TRAINER-role caller linking as a student -> 409 ConflictError (unchanged).

DATA MODEL additions: trainers/{id} now carries userId, active (mirror of status==='active'), referralCodeUpdatedAt (status stays the single authoritative active flag). referralCodes/{codeLower} now carries code (display), active, createdAt, updatedAt (trainerId still authoritative-for-ownership via the trainer doc). trainerLinks/{studentUid} shape unchanged.

SHARED CLAIMABILITY PREDICATE (used by claim + availability): claimable by T iff referralCodes/{codeLower} is missing OR owned by T (active or inactive); unavailable iff owned by a DIFFERENT trainer regardless of active.

Generator util: backend/src/utils/referralCode.ts exports generateCandidate(rng?) and normalize(code). Repo: getByReferralCodeDoc / claimReferralCode / deactivateReferralCode / setActiveReferralCodeOnTrainer (+ trainerDoc/referralCodeDoc refs); setReferralCode removed.

SCRIPTS: seedTrainer.ts repurposed to a generic dev helper (SEED_TRAINER_UID + optional SEED_TRAINER_NAME; GENERATED code; no dreamphysics). NEW migrateReferralCodes.ts (npm run migrate:referral-codes) backfills trainers/* + referralCodes/* without the validator (grandfathers dreamphysics), never touches trainerLinks. Both require real Firebase creds and are run manually, not in CI.

DEVIATIONS: none from the approved design. firebase/firestore.rules + firestore.indexes.json need NO change (confirmed per design) and were not touched.
